ROUND 1 security PASS WITH NOTES for PR #260 at c270201970dbd55bf1f11c9ed3d7d2491c5be8e6.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No vulnerabilities found | - |

The security-review specialist found no vulnerabilities in the exact base/head diff. The OMP launch uses fixed arguments without a shell and explicitly sets repository-root cwd. Inherited PATH/environment remain within the C33 trusted-user boundary. Static config parsing does not execute configuration text. No project-to-global config linkage is introduced; no committed secret or prohibited private/home-path disclosure was found.

Nonblocking execution/validation note: harness/scripts/omp-config-check.ts:39 invokes installed OMP. Static inspection identified that the installed OMP config handler initializes persistent settings/storage and may perform global migrations or marker writes even for config get. Thus the absence of an explicit config write in this PR does not certify strict global-filesystem read-only behavior. I did not run the live sensor, preserving the no-global-change constraint. This is not an exploitable-security finding; distinguish project config linkage/settings changes from incidental initialization by the installed CLI.

Validation: just pr-freeze 260 ran inside a nice -n 19 shell and returned FINAL at the requested SHA: main base, CLEAN merge, ready, unchanged migration numbering and passing CI check (22), check (24), rust-lint, rust-test and Delivers. The detached review worktree is clean. No local tests, builds, cargo commands, dependency installs, OMP commands, credential-file reads or global-config changes were performed.

Known limits: static security review only; the cwd-sensitive project-layer behavior and live sensor cost remain with the correctness/performance reviews.
